description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rajanganata Yaya 15, Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110182
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owners' details, and land classifications. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
